theme_strategy: Pure OLED black theme (#000000) with deep slate containers, electric cobalt/neon blue buttons & kinetic accents (#2563EB / #3B82F6), stark white typography (#FFFFFF), and vivid crimson (#EF4444) for loss/negative simulated states. Precision tactical minimalism tailored for Deriv Volatility Index digit trading simulation.

entry_surfaces./: split-cockpit dashboard — header nav with Deriv account & token status, left panel live tick telemetry & digit distribution strip, center-right panel simulation execution engine with 0–9 digit matrix, Matches/Differs toggle & session ledger

layout_architecture.container_type: full-width responsive command cockpit with max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6

structure.pattern: Sticky crystal glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/85 border-b border-border/60)
structure.content: Deriv Edge Lab logo with pulse indicator + Deriv Demo badge + live account balance ($10,000.00 USD) + API Token / OAuth Connect Dialog trigger + Market Status indicator

structure.pattern: Bento row with Active Volatility Index selector (1HZ10V, 1HZ25V, 1HZ50V, 1HZ75V, 1HZ100V, R_10, R_25, R_50, R_75, R_100), current real-time tick price with flashing last digit, and 10-tick rolling digit trail

structure.section: Bottom Section: Real-time Execution Ledger & Live Digit Frequency
structure.pattern: 2-column bento split (lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4): Col-span-7 trade history table with instant outcome badges & Col-span-5 interactive 0–9 frequency distribution bar chart

market_selector.type: Shadcn Select / Pill selector with Volatility indices

trade_type_toggle.matches_description: Win condition: Last digit EQUALS predicted digit (Payout ~9.5x virtual return)
trade_type_toggle.differs_description: Win condition: Last digit DIFFERS from predicted digit (Payout ~1.09x virtual return)

digit_selector_grid.type: 10-button keypad grid (0 to 9) with large tactile numbers, selection glow, and hotkey support

stake_input.type: Custom Shadcn Input with quick-stake chips ($1, $5, $10, $25, $50, $100)

simulation_action_buttons.type: High-visibility primary trigger: Start Simulation (Bright Blue / Electric Indigo), Stop Simulation (Crimson/Red outline or solid), Single Step Tick Test

account_modal.type: Shadcn Dialog for Deriv Connection (Demo API Token input, Demo/Real account switcher, WebSocket latency monitor, OAuth simulator)

motion_and_microinteractions.tick_flash: Flashing highlight (blue glow for match, subtle pulse) when a new tick arrives from Deriv WebSocket
motion_and_microinteractions.digit_badge_pop: Scale pop (scale-110 to scale-100) when the last tick digit matches the selected digit
motion_and_microinteractions.win_burst: Subtle green particle flash / glow border on win outcome
motion_and_microinteractions.loss_pulse: Clean crimson border pulse on simulated loss outcome
motion_and_microinteractions.hover_states: All buttons transition bg-color, border, and subtle shadow within 150ms
motion_and_microinteractions.reduced_motion: Prefers-reduced-motion media query disables scale transforms and keeps opacity transitions under 100ms

accessibility.wcag_compliance: AA rating across pure black #000000 background
accessibility.aria_roles: Proper role='status' for live tick stream, aria-pressed for digit grid buttons, aria-live='polite' for session P/L and result announcer
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full arrow key navigation and 0-9 numpad shortcuts for digit picking

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the user's explicit design requirement: Pure black background (#000000), Stark white text (#FFFFFF), Electric blue accents and buttons (#2563EB / #3B82F6), Crimson red for losses (#EF4444), and Emerald green for wins (#10B981).
Set the HTML class='dark' in frontend/index.html and configure index.css with Outfit and JetBrains Mono.

Implement real Deriv WebSocket connectivity (wss://ws.derivws.com/websockets/v3?app_id=1089 or custom token) for live ticks (R_10, R_25, R_50, R_75, R_100, 1HZ10V, 1HZ100V) with robust fallback live generator so it works seamlessly even if offline or without API token.
Support both Demo token connection and Quick Demo Simulation Mode (with $10,000 virtual balance).
Strictly enforce: This is a SIMULATOR. No real money trades are placed. All trades evaluate the real-time live last digit against the user's selected Matches or Differs condition.
Provide clear Matches (payout ~9.5x) vs Differs (payout ~1.09x) mathematical payout ratios in simulation.
Include a real-time Last-10 Digits visual strip and a 0–9 Digit Frequency Distribution bar chart using Recharts.
Add complete session statistics: Total Runs, Wins, Losses, Win Rate %, Virtual Profit/Loss ($ and %), Current Streak, and Peak Balance.
Implement a downloadable / clearable Trade History ledger with time, symbol, trade type, predicted digit, actual digit, stake, profit/loss, and timestamp.
Ensure every interactive element has kebab-case data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered tactical borders (1px border-border/80) with crisp contrast.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add specific transitions for interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container — maintain natural left-aligned data reading flow.
Use modern pill-shaped or crisp sharp buttons with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons — use Lucide icons only.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, tick pulses, badge changes.
Use generous spacing (gap-4, gap-6, p-6) to ensure the tactical dashboard feels spacious and uncrowded.
